We have combined subnets with connections as guessed: S1: A-N1-R1, N1-X1-R2. S2: X1-N_b1-R1, N_b1-X2-R2, N_b1-N_extra-R3 (extra node maybe not needed). S3: X2-B three parallel resistors R1,R2,R3.

Simulated A-B resistance matches measurement 41.364 (41.3636). A-N_b1 matches 11.667 (measurement 11.667). Need also other measurements: A-X1 should be 6.667, A-X2 25.0, B-N_b1 29.697, B-X1 34.697, B-X2 16.364, N_b1-X1 5.0, N_b1-X2 13.333, X1-X2 18.333. Let's test a few.
